title: UPDATE: SpaceX Launches Grok for Startups with Credit Matching Program

tickers.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
India's Tech Mahindra has partnered with SpaceXSI to develop AI powered software, while a new incentive program for startups now offers 6 to 12 months of credits across Grok, Grok Build, Grok Bot and the API. The offer matches every dollar spent by these new developers 1:1 in free credits for the following six months to encourage technical builds on the platform.

These initiatives are part of the SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network, which currently includes over 130 companies such as Nvidia and Apollo Global Management. The network's goal is to bolster business adoption by allowing firms to deploy and refine Grok AI systems through corporate workflows and real world applications.
